update.methodHint: Choose how you installed dtxWiki to see the update steps.
update.prepareDescription: Read the release notes and documentation prerequisites first. Stop the server and any separately run worker, then back up the database, files, and configuration.
update.npxPrepareDescription: Choose the target version from npm. Before starting, run the release's required checks with that version, for example npx @dtxsuite/dtxwiki@<version> inputs audit. Complete any required repair or migration steps in the documentation.

instructions.uv: Run in the environment used for the original uv tool installation. Keep its Python interpreter options and package index/authentication configuration.
instructions.pipx: Use the original pipx environment and Python interpreter options. Keep any package index/authentication configuration.
instructions.pip: Activate the original virtual environment, then run this command with its Python interpreter and existing package index/authentication configuration.
instructions.npx: Replace @latest below with the same npm version used for the checks in step 1. Start only after those checks pass, using your usual server options and environment variables.
instructions.npm: Update the global npm package using the same user and npm environment as the original installation.
instructions.docker: Follow the documented backup, pinned-version image rebuild, migration, and container recreation procedure for your Compose configuration.
instructions.service: Follow the documented verified-wheel, service stop, upgrade, migration, and service start procedure for your deployment.

update.noPinnedCommand: A fresh newer Python release has not been confirmed. Check now, or follow the documentation to select a version without downgrading.
update.uvPythonNote: Requires Python 3.12 or newer. Optionally add --python <version> to the uv command to select a particular interpreter.
update.npmVersionNote: @latest uses the npm registry. Its version may differ from the Python package index shown above.
update.restartDescription: Complete the documented migration and release checks, then restart using your existing command, environment, and options. Refresh this page to confirm the running version.
update.verifyDescription: The command in step 2 starts the server. Refresh this page to confirm the running version; do not launch a second server.
update.description: Check the latest release and follow the guide for your installation.
